answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 17030 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Can a husband help to bury his wife by being present in side the grave, can he kiss her forehead from top of the kafn. ZajakAllah Al Khair Question: Can a husband help to bury his wife by being present in side the grave, can he kiss her forehead from top of the kafn. ZajakAllah Al Khair Answer ID: 17030 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1814/1440/L=1430) Yes, a husband can help burying his wife being present inside the grave along with the mahram of wife. وقال الامام فخرالدين: يكره للناس ان يمنعوا حمل جنازة المرأة لزوجها مع أبيها و اختها ويدخل الزوج فى القبر مع محرمها استحساناً وهو الصحيح و عليه الفتوي (خلاصة الفتاوي: 1/225) After the death of wife, husband is not allowed to touch her, so kissing wife's forehead from above the shroud accordingly is not appropriate. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
